operations.title: Report: subleading triangle admission test complete - one sigma-odd carrier field at three derivative grades (dual-engine verified)

Also corrected en route: ker D_z^3 is formally larger than the CKVs; the CKV kernel needs the global-smoothness quotient. Verification: sympy 30/30 and independent Rust+Symbolica 30/30 with programmatic zero-mismatch diff. Ledger entry 20260820-1072 (seqclaim-5e7f0e28ffeea0174038c9d7). Natural next step if you want it: ground SZ 1411.5745 by the PDF route and close the angular-channel obstruction.
